ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure lists 4 restriction endonucleases and their recognition/cutting sites: EcoRI corresponds to GAATTC/CTTAAG, forming sticky ends after cutting; SmaI corresponds to CCCGGG/GGGCCC, forming blunt ends after cutting; PstI corresponds to CTGCAG/GACGTC, forming sticky ends after cutting; EcoRV corresponds to GATATC/CTATAG, forming blunt ends after cutting. Reasoning: The question asks which DNA fragments cut by these restriction enzymes can be ligated with T4 DNA ligase. T4 DNA ligase can ligate DNA fragments with sticky ends as well as DNA fragments with blunt ends. Therefore DNA fragments cut by all 4 restriction enzymes in the figure can be ligated by T4 DNA ligase.
